create_InBatch_module: create an InBatch module with options for normalization, label smoothing, and a retriever model
load_retriever_with_InBatch: load a Contriever or XLMRetriever model and tokenizer using the InBatch _load_retriever method
run_InBatch_forward: run the InBatch forward pass with query and key tokens to compute in-batch contrastive loss
get_encoder_from_InBatch: get the retriever encoder from an InBatch module using the get_encoder method
review_InBatch_class: review the InBatch class for in-batch negative contrastive learning with distributed gathering
